# Terminal assets

Vendored from the published npm packages, with their upstream MIT licenses:

- `@xterm/xterm` 5.5.0: `lib/xterm.js`, `css/xterm.css`, `LICENSE`
- `@xterm/addon-fit` 0.10.0: `lib/addon-fit.js`, `LICENSE`

Pocket Dev serves these files locally so its interface loads without external
CDN access. Update the JavaScript, CSS, and corresponding license together.
